{{Quote|We proceeded down Guildhead's Way, a broad avenue that provided an unobstructed path to the government center.|Colonel Maximilian Veers, Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Guildhead's Way''' was an avenue in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salline/Legends|Salline]] on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], which led to the [[Government center (Salline)|government center]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime in between [[2 BBY/Legends|2]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] [[Pacification of Salline|invaded]] Salline with the intention of taking the government center using the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] [[Hammer 6]] and [[Hammer 8|eight]], as well as four [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]]. The AT-ATs advanced down the avenue, and Hammer 6 came under attack twice from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] forces hidden inside the upper stories of buildings using missile batteries. The second attack caused Hammer 6's hip joint to seize up, so the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Hammer 8, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], ordered it to remain behind and serve as a 180 degree elevated turret. The Empire ultimately won the battle, with Hammer 8 routing the Rebel forces in the government center. Veers later mentioned Guildhead's Way in his report on the battle, which became known as the Pacification of Salline, and was included in the [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
